Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the family’s illnesses, add Shennong’s feeling or thought to show his motivation: “神农很担心家人，心想：我一定要找到能治病的植物。”
2. Make the journey’s places more vivid with one sensory detail: “高山又高又冷，山谷里开着很多花。”
3. Add a short description of the brothers’ effort during the trip: “他们走了很远的路，脚都累了。”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting motivation and simple direct thought without changing the story.
It gives concrete, level-appropriate detail about places already mentioned.
It adds a plausible action and physical detail to their journey.
